scenarios.description: Clean success: model reads context, writes fix, tests all pass. No loops, budget comfortable.
Success with iterative test fixes: tests first fail, then pass after targeted file edits.
Exact-repeat loop: same fingerprint repeated with no progress. Policy pauses on the 3rd occurrence (exact_repeat_limit=3).
Repeat loop broken by progress: fingerprint repeats reach limit but diff_bytes>0 on action 3 sets made_progress=True, suppressing the pause. Run recovers and succeeds.
Semantic loop: high cosine similarity (>=0.95) with no progress. Pauses when semantic_repeats reaches semantic_repeat_limit=2.
Policy default_action=downgrade: every action is routed to the cheaper ollama profile. Run completes successfully with downgraded model.
Run budget cap exceeded: run_cap=3000 micro-USD. Three actions complete (total spent=2850); fourth action pushes run_spent+estimated over cap → pause.
Provider quota exhausted: second action reports quota_exhausted. fail_safe.on_provider_quota_failure=pause → run stops.
Quota exhausted triggers downgrade to ollama. Run continues on the cheaper profile and succeeds.
Provider timeout error: not a quota error, but the generic provider_error path in the engine still uses on_provider_quota_failure=pause → run stops.
Hosted egress consent required: policy has hosted_egress.enabled=True but the simulated agent has hosted_egress_allowed=False → immediate pause.
Organization budget cap exceeded: org_cap=2000 micro-USD, tight. Two actions complete (org_spent=1900); third pushes org total over cap → pause.
Test-writing workflow: plan, implement tests, iterate until all pass. Eight actions, all allowed, verified success.
Multi-action with progressive test improvements: context read, model planning, implementation, three test rounds, final review. Nine actions all allowed.

Exact-repeat suppressed by made_progress: fingerprint repeats reach the limit (3>=3) on action 2, but diff_bytes>0 sets made_progress=True, suppressing the pause. Run succeeds — demonstrates a training 'near-miss'.
Default downgrade policy with run_cap=50000: every action is downgraded to local-ollama regardless of other signals. Run completes successfully.

Data classification blocked: agent has hosted egress consent (hosted_egress_allowed=True) but submits 'confidential' data. Policy only allows ['public','internal'] → pause (data_classification_not_allowed).
Ollama local success: CI configuration is written and validated. Four actions, larger virtual budget, no loops or errors.
Ollama exact-repeat loop: local model generates identical outputs with no file change. Pauses on 3rd occurrence.
Ollama virtual budget limit: run_cap=15000 micro-USD (tight for local compute). Three actions complete (spent=14400); fourth pushes over cap → pause.
Ollama semantic loop: ONNX embeddings show high cosine similarity (>=0.95) across three responses with no code change → pause on action 2.
Ollama success with mixed action types: model exploration (same fp twice), file migration, test run with 1 failure, targeted fix. Five actions all allowed.
